text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo hasn't shown up for training.
Worried, I
go looking for her.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...So I decided to tell the reporters this:

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this needs quotes as well."I,
King Halo,
the most intelligent and
first-rate Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Shall one day reign from atop the
world!"

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You really are the coolest, King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! But of course. That's no
trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll even sign ones for your family and
friends. I'll
sign every piece of paper you
have!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear King Halo feels bad for missing
practice.
